title: Tooling Master

purpose.en: Plate sets and dies by dieline reference, with status and mounting minutes. Scheduling blocks a job whose tool is not ready and adds the mounting time to the setup.
purpose.id: Set plat dan pisau menurut referensi dieline, dengan status dan menit pasang. Penjadwalan menahan job yang tooling-nya belum siap dan menambah waktu pasang ke setup.

keywords: tooling, plat, pisau, die, plate set, cutting die, setup, dieline, master tooling

steps.en: Open Tooling Master. The list is a sheet where you type in the cells.
steps.id: Buka Tooling Master. Daftarnya berupa lembar yang diisi langsung di sel.

steps.en: Add a row: Code, Type, Dieline Reference and Status are required. Use the Dieline Reference of the part in Product Development.
steps.id: Tambah baris: Code, Type, Dieline Reference dan Status wajib. Pakai Dieline Reference part di Product Development.

steps.en: Fill Setup First Run and Setup Repeat Run in minutes. They are assumed values until real jobs are recorded.
steps.id: Isi Setup First Run dan Setup Repeat Run dalam menit. Keduanya nilai asumsi sampai job nyata tercatat.

steps.en: Change Status when the tool is made, in use or needs repair. Click Save.
steps.id: Ubah Status saat tooling selesai dibuat, dipakai atau perlu perbaikan. Klik Save.

fields.label: Status
fields.en: Ready or In use lets scheduling plan the job. Not made, In making or Needs repair blocks it with a reason.
fields.id: Ready atau In use membuat penjadwalan menjadwalkan job. Not made, In making atau Needs repair menahannya dengan alasan.

fields.label: Setup First Run (min)
fields.en: Minutes to mount this tool when it is new on the machine.
fields.id: Menit memasang tooling ini saat baru di mesin.

fields.label: Setup Repeat Run (min)
fields.en: Minutes to mount it again for a repeat order.
fields.id: Menit memasangnya lagi untuk order ulang.

title: Wait Rules

purpose.en: Minutes the next process must wait after a process, for example ink drying or coating curing. Scheduling puts the wait between the two steps of a Work Order.
purpose.id: Menit yang harus ditunggu proses berikutnya setelah sebuah proses, misalnya tinta kering atau coating curing. Penjadwalan menaruh tunggu di antara dua langkah Work Order.

keywords: wait rule, tunggu, pengeringan, curing, drying, jeda proses

steps.en: Open Wait Rules and add a row.
steps.id: Buka Wait Rules dan tambah baris.

steps.en: Type the start of the process name (for example CETAK or VARNISH) and the wait in minutes.
steps.id: Ketik awal nama proses (misalnya CETAK atau VARNISH) dan waktu tunggu dalam menit.

steps.en: Click Save. The next plan run uses it; the machine is free during the wait.
steps.id: Klik Save. Rencana berikutnya memakainya; mesin bebas selama menunggu.

fields.label: After Process (name starts with)
fields.en: The process the wait follows. A name that starts with these letters matches.
fields.id: Proses yang diikuti waktu tunggu. Nama yang diawali huruf ini cocok.

fields.label: Wait (min)
fields.en: Minimum minutes before the next process may start.
fields.id: Menit minimum sebelum proses berikutnya boleh mulai.

title: Setup and Changeover

purpose.en: Extra minutes and waste sheets when a machine changes colour, ink type, substrate, size, plate or die. Scheduling adds them to the base setup between two jobs; the learning engine corrects Assumed values.
purpose.id: Menit dan lembar waste tambahan saat mesin ganti warna, jenis tinta, bahan, ukuran, plat atau pisau. Penjadwalan menambahkannya ke setup dasar; engine pembelajar mengoreksi nilai Assumed.

keywords: changeover, setup, ganti warna, ganti plat, ganti pisau, waktu setup, pembelajaran

steps.en: Open Setup and Changeover and add a row for a machine and a kind of change.
steps.id: Buka Setup and Changeover dan tambah baris untuk sebuah mesin dan jenis perubahan.

steps.en: Fill Extra Minutes and Extra Waste. Leave Value Status on Assumed for a start value.
steps.id: Isi Extra Minutes dan Extra Waste. Biarkan Value Status Assumed untuk nilai awal.

steps.en: Tick Frozen to stop the learning engine from changing a row. Click Save.
steps.id: Centang Frozen agar engine pembelajar tidak mengubah baris. Klik Save.

fields.label: Value Status
fields.en: Assumed is a start value; Learning and Calibrated were adjusted from real jobs.
fields.id: Assumed adalah nilai awal; Learning dan Calibrated sudah disesuaikan dari job nyata.

fields.label: Samples
fields.en: How many finished jobs the current value is based on. Set by the engine.
fields.id: Berapa job selesai yang mendasari nilai sekarang. Diisi engine.

fields.label: Frozen
fields.en: The learning engine never changes a frozen row.
fields.id: Engine pembelajar tidak pernah mengubah baris yang dibekukan.
